name: Cornbread Salad
description: A layered salad with crumbled cornbread, black beans, corn, cheese, and a creamy dressing, perfect for chilling before serving.
recipeIngredient: 1 (11 oz) can whole kernel corn, drained
1 (15 oz) can black beans, rinsed and drained
½ cup salad dressing or mayonnaise
½ cup chopped fresh cilantro or parsley
6 plum or tiny tim tomatoes, shredded

recipeInstructions.text: Prepare cornbread mix according to package directions and let cool. Crumble into pieces.
In a food processor or blender, combine salad dressing (or mayonnaise), lime juice, cumin, and salt. Process until smooth.
Layer half of the lettuce, cornbread, dressing mixture, beans, corn, cheese, red bell pepper, green onions, and tomatoes in a 4-quart bowl.
Repeat the layers, finishing with the remaining dressing on top. Garnish as desired with cilantro or onion curls.
Cover and chill for 1 to 2 hours before serving.

keywords: Cornbread salad, layered salad, Southwestern salad

_similar.name: Sauerkraut Salad
_similar.description: A tangy and crunchy salad featuring sauerkraut, chopped vegetables, and a sweet-and-sour dressing that keeps well in the refrigerator.
recipeIngredient: 1 (28 oz) jar or can sauerkraut, drained

recipeInstructions.text: Heat the vinegar, sugar, and salt in a saucepan until boiling.
Let the dressing cool to room temperature.
In a large bowl, combine the drained sauerkraut, chopped celery, onion, red pepper, and green pepper.
Pour the cooled dressing over the salad and toss to coat.
Store in a sealed container in the refrigerator for up to 2-3 weeks.

_similar.name: Pasta Salad
_similar.description: A colorful pasta salad with penne or spiral pasta, vegetables, feta cheese, and a tangy herb dressing.
recipeIngredient: ½ bag penne or spiral pasta

recipeInstructions.text: Cook the pasta according to package instructions, then drain and cool.
Add chopped green pepper, tomatoes, green onions, and sliced black olives to the cooled pasta.
Crumble the feta cheese into the pasta mixture.
Pour the Classic Herb dressing over the salad and toss to combine.

_similar.name: Romaine Salad with Orange
_similar.description: A refreshing salad featuring romaine lettuce, oranges, and red onion with a light vinaigrette dressing.
recipeIngredient: ¼ cup red wine vinegar or cider vinegar

recipeInstructions.text: In a large bowl, combine the torn romaine lettuce, drained mandarin oranges, and thinly sliced red onion.
In a separate bowl, combine the red wine vinegar, oil, minced parsley, garlic, salt, and pepper to make the dressing.
Pour the dressing over the salad and toss to coat.
Serve immediately.

_similar.keywords: romaine salad, orange salad, vinaigrette dressing

_similar.name: Mexican Salad
_similar.description: A hearty and flavorful salad with kidney beans, lentils, and low-fat cheese, topped with salsa and served with taco chips.
recipeIngredient: ½ cup low-fat cheese (mozzarella or cheddar or combination)

recipeInstructions.text: Combine kidney beans, lentils, diced tomato, shredded lettuce, chopped green pepper, low-fat cheese, and green onions in a large bowl.
Toss the salad with Catalina dressing until well coated.
Top the salad with salsa.
Serve immediately with taco chips on the side.

_similar.keywords: Mexican salad, bean salad, taco chips

_similar.name: Taco Salad
_similar.description: A hearty taco salad with seasoned ground beef, crunchy taco chips, and cheddar cheese, all tossed in Catalina dressing.

recipeInstructions.text: Cook ground beef until crumbly, drain off fat, and season with taco seasoning mix.
Refrigerate the cooked beef until ready to use.
Toss together the cooled beef, chopped lettuce, crushed taco chips, and shredded cheddar cheese.
Mix in Catalina dressing until well coated.
Carefully add in chopped tomato.
Serve immediately.

_similar.keywords: taco salad, ground beef, taco chips, cheddar cheese
